title: Put your hope where the world cannot reach
summary: This meets the body that keeps bracing for the next blow, opinion, or reversal. The line says the world's reach weakens when hope is placed in the Lord.
takeaway: Let hope outrank the world's reach.
lifeApplication: Before opening the message or walking into the room, feel the shoulders and stop rehearsing the hit. Let hope settle higher than the situation.

source.shortMeaning: Hope in the Lord lifts the heart beyond the world's reach.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next anxious scan, lift the gaze and place your trust above the circumstance.
